ЗАЧЕМ ОТДЕЛЬНЫМ ФАЙЛОМ, а не вторым services.json: сам прайс генерируется автоматически скриптом build_services.py и перезаписывается при каждом обновлении цен — вторая копия данных неизбежно разъехалась бы с первой. Здесь только переводы ТЕРМИНОВ; цены, модели и наличие всегда берутся из основного services.json. Если в прайсе появится операция или класс запчасти, которых тут нет, скрипт покажет русское название — выдача не сломается, просто одна подпись будет по-русски. Добавлено 17.08.2026.

quality.title: Which part is which, and how the warranty depends on it

дисплей_original_100.name: 100% Original
дисплей_original_100.desc: An original display pulled from a brand-new device. Colour, brightness, sunlight legibility, True Tone and the feel of the glass are exactly as they left the factory. The most expensive option — and the only one you genuinely cannot tell from a new phone.

дисплей_orig_lcd.name: Orig LCD (commonly called FOG)
дисплей_orig_lcd.desc: A factory refurbishment: an original-grade panel bonded to new glass and a new digitiser. In everyday use it is practically indistinguishable from the original — you would need lab equipment to tell. A sensible middle ground when the original is too expensive but you do not want to lose quality.
cons: the origin of the panel cannot be guaranteed

дисплей_oled.name: Soft OLED / Hard OLED
дисплей_oled.desc: An aftermarket OLED panel. Deep blacks and proper viewing angles; in daily use the difference from the original is hard to spot. Soft OLED sits on a flexible backing — closer to the original in thickness and better at surviving a drop. Hard OLED is rigid and cheaper.
cons: lower peak brightness than the original

дисплей_копия.name: In-Cell TFT
дисплей_копия.desc: The most affordable option. The screen works and looks tidy, but it is an LCD: black looks closer to dark grey, viewing angles are worse, and it is harder to read in bright sunlight. Usually chosen when price matters most, or when preparing a device for sale.

акб_привязка_подлинный.name: Paired, shows as «Genuine»
акб_привязка_подлинный.short: The system recognises the battery as genuine
акб_привязка_подлинный.desc: After fitting, the iPhone still reports battery health and does not complain about a non-genuine part. The best option for iPhone 12 and newer.
cons: costs more than a standard replacement

акб_ориг_чип.name: Original controller
акб_ориг_чип.desc: A new battery with an original controller chip. Real capacity matches the rating and charging behaves normally. The standard choice for models older than iPhone 12.
cons: on iPhone 12 and newer a part warning may appear

акб_привязка_бу.name: Paired, shows as «Used»
акб_привязка_бу.short: Pairs correctly, but is flagged as used
акб_привязка_бу.desc: The battery fits as if it were factory-installed, but the system marks it as previously used. A compromise between price and how the system behaves.

акб_копия.name: Copy controller
акб_копия.desc: The cheapest option. The phone works, but the system will show a non-genuine part warning and battery health may not be displayed at all. Real capacity is usually below the original.

important.text: From iPhone 12 onwards Apple pairs the display and the battery to the device. If a part is not paired, the iPhone will say it cannot verify that the part is genuine, and battery health may stop being displayed. It does not affect how the phone works, but it is worth knowing before you choose.
True Tone does not survive every type of screen replacement. On originals and good refurbished panels it usually does; on budget copies it usually does not.

Face ID does not depend on the screen — it lives in a separate module and keeps working after a careful replacement. It fails when that module itself is damaged, not because of which screen you choose.

conditions.text: Glass-only work replaces just the outer glass; the panel that actually produces the image stays original. So it fits when the glass is cracked but the image is fine. If there are stripes, dead spots or blackout areas, the whole module has to be replaced.
The digitiser is the thin film under the glass that registers your touch. If it works fully and without glitches, in most cases it survives the process and stays original.

conditions.topic: On some models the digitiser is at risk
conditions.text: On certain models the digitiser can fail while the glass is being removed. It is then replaced with a new one — good quality, but no longer original. On a few models it cannot be replaced at all. Ask us which group your model falls into.
